title: 文A。それで 文B
shortExplanation: Used to connect two sentences; 'So', 'That's why', 'Therefore'.
longExplanation: The grammar point 文A。それで 文B is used to connect two sentences and show that the second sentence (文B) is a result or consequence of the first sentence (文A). It can be translated as 'so', 'that's why', or 'therefore' in English.

examples.jp: 今日は暑いです。それで、エアコンをつけました。
examples.romaji: Kyou wa atsui desu. Sorede, eakon wo tsukemashita.
examples.en: It is hot today. So, I turned on the air conditioner.

examples.jp: 電車が遅れました。それで、仕事に遅れてしまいました。
examples.romaji: Densha ga okuremashita. Sorede, shigoto ni okurete shimaimashita.
examples.en: The train was delayed. That's why I was late for work.

words.reading: おくれてしまいました

examples.jp: 彼は疲れている。それで、早く寝ることにした。
examples.romaji: Kare wa tsukarete iru. Sorede, hayaku neru koto ni shita.
examples.en: He is tired. Therefore, he decided to go to bed early.

examples.jp: 試験に合格しました。それで、友達とお祝いパーティーを開きました。
examples.romaji: Shiken ni goukaku shimashita. Sorede, tomodachi to oiwai paatii wo hirakimashita.
examples.en: I passed the exam. So, I held a celebration party with friends.

usageNote: Casual "and then/so" - conversational, often prompts the listener for what happened next. (Near-duplicate of n2-011's それで, sentence-initial form.)
